lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters is visible on the posterior-dorsal surface. The centroids form longitudinal rows with spacing between spots approximately 1.5 to 2 times the spot diameter, increasing in size towards the medial ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the longitudinal rows of spots, forming a lattice where the spots occupy the center of the vertical band intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral edge, running parallel to the long axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least six commensal organisms (Echeneidae) visible trailing and attached to the posterior and ventral edges of the right pectoral fin.
